description: This file defines a logging API and interfaces for structured logging in Go, including the Logger type, LogSink interface, and related helper interfaces and functions.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A concrete type representing a logger that defers actual logging to a LogSink interface, supporting structured logging, verbosity levels, and context.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Logger instance with a specified LogSink.

methods.name: setSink
methods.description: Sets the sink for the Logger; internal use.

methods.name: GetSink
methods.description: Returns the current LogSink associated with the Logger.

methods.name: WithSink
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Logger with a new LogSink.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if the Logger is enabled based on the LogSink and level.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs a structured info message with key/value pairs.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Logs an error message with context and optional error object.

methods.name: V
methods.description: Returns a new Logger with increased verbosity level.

methods.name: WithValues
methods.description: Returns a new Logger with additional key/value pairs for context.

methods.name: WithName
methods.description: Returns a new Logger with an appended name segment.

methods.name: WithCallDepth
methods.description: Returns a Logger offsetting call stack frames for call site attribution.

methods.name: WithCallStackHelper
methods.description: Returns a helper function and a Logger that skips helper functions in call site info.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.description: Checks if the Logger is uninitialized.
